messages:
release-coordinator: Heads up — starting prod canary in 10m (10% traffic for 15m). TL;DR backout plan pinned: immediate revert to release v1.4.2 and route traffic to the warm pool if errors breach threshold. Runbook links below. :eyes:

deploybot: [deploybot] canary rollout scheduled by @release-coordinator for service: api-service environment: prod strategy: canary-10pct duration:15m commit: 9f3a2b7

laura: Quick Q — any schema/migration in this release?

release-coordinator: No DB migrations. Safe to hot-revert. main risk is model-serving cache invalidation on nodes (watch 429s + cache-miss rate).

mike: I'll shadow the errors dashboard and look at p50/p95. If error_rate > 2.5% for 5m or latency p95 > 350ms trigger backout. :thumbsup:

sre_oncall: Agreed. Backout trigger criteria in runbook: 
- error_rate >= 2.5% sustained over a 5m window OR
- user-facing 5xx spike + rollbackable change flag set
If triggered, do the following (quick commands):
```bash
# pin routing to v1.4.2
rcli routing set --service api-service --version v1.4.2 --reason "auto-backout-criteria"
# fallback to warm pool nodes
infractl pool attach --pool warm-api --service api-service
# mark incident and notify stakeholders
incident create --title "Auto-backout: api-service" --severity P1 --assignee @sre_oncall
```

ops-bot: Runbook reference: https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/backout-api-service (section: quick-escape-hatch). Also runbook snippet: "If pin fails, run emergency-rollback.sh on deploy coordinator host and open a support VPN."

laura: Noted. I'll keep an eye on cache-miss rate and pre-warm if needed. If we need to rollback, I can run the attach/pin steps — ping me.

deploybot: [deploybot] canary rollout started — 10% traffic -> 3 hosts (host-21, host-22, host-23). Monitoring enabled: errors, latency, model-cache-miss.

mike: Watching dashboards now: initial 10m baseline looks clean. p95 ~ 220ms, errors 0.4%. :thumbsup:

(8m later)
sre_oncall: Observability note — spike in 429s from host-22, cache-miss 12% -> temp elevated 4xx. Taking host-22 out of rotation for canary.

release-coordinator: Good move. Removing host-22 from canary and rebalancing. If further degradation, execute backout.

mike: After removing host-22 p95 back to 230ms, errors 0.6%. continuing monitoring.

(14m after start)
sre_oncall: Canary window complete with no sustained error threshold breach. Marking canary success. Proceed to gradual rollout to 50% as planned. Recording decisions in runbook. :white_check_mark:

release-coordinator: Thanks all. Post-deploy tasks: update release notes, tag release stable, and close the temporary incident if any.

ops-bot: Log: deploy(9f3a2b7) canary->success; rollout next step scheduled. Backout runbook snapshot saved to https://wiki.redwood/inference/runbooks/snapshots/2345678901
